module.birthday.name: TSQ Birthday
module.birthday.description: Members save their birthday as day and month (no year); one celebration message when the day starts and the Birthday role for that day.
birthday.set.unchanged: 🎂 Your birthday is already saved as {0}.
birthday.set.invalid: ❌ That date is not valid. Enter day and month, e.g. 14.03 (14/03 and 14-03 work too). No year needed.
birthday.set.reminder: 🎂 Please enter your real birthday. It matters to us.
birthday.show.none: 🎂 You have no saved birthday. To add one: /birthday set 14.03
birthday.remove.none: 🎂 You had no saved birthday; nothing was deleted.
birthday.announce.many:
🎂 Today is the birthday of {0}!
Happy birthday to you all! 🥳
birthday.admin_set.forbidden: ❌ You need the Administrator permission for this.
birthday.admin_set.not_member: ❌ This person is not a member of this server, or is a bot; no birthday can be saved.
birthday.admin_show.not_member: ❌ This person is not a member of this server, or is a bot.
birthday.config.channel_invalid: This channel cannot be used: it must be a text channel in this server that the bot can see.
birthday.config.saved: Birthday announcements will now be posted in {0}.
birthday.config.saved_missing_permission: Saved: {0}. Warning: the bot is missing permissions there ({1}); announcements cannot be sent.
birthday.status.title: TSQ Birthday status
birthday.status.scheduler_not_running: not running (no background work in this process)
birthday.status.scheduler_no_pass: started, waiting for the first pass
birthday.doctor.title: TSQ Birthday diagnostics
birthday.doctor.module_off: disabled — no announcement, no role (/modules enable birthday)
birthday.doctor.channel_missing: FAILED: not set — nothing is announced (/tsq-admin birthday configure)
birthday.doctor.channel_gone: FAILED: {0} not found or not visible to the bot
birthday.doctor.channel_problem: FAILED: Discord reported {0} on the last send — configure the channel again
birthday.doctor.role_unverifiable: FAILED: the server is not visible over the Discord connection, role {0} cannot be checked
birthday.doctor.role_missing: FAILED: role {0} does not exist in this server
birthday.doctor.manage_roles_missing: FAILED: the bot lacks Manage Roles
birthday.doctor.hierarchy_ok: passed · the bot's highest role (position {0}) is above the Birthday role (position {1})
birthday.doctor.hierarchy_failed: FAILED: the bot's highest role (position {0}) is not above the Birthday role (position {1}) — the role cannot be given; move the bot's role up
birthday.doctor.managed_failed: FAILED: a role managed by an integration — the bot cannot give it
birthday.doctor.role_permissions_failed: FAILED: the role grants permissions @everyone does not have ({0}) — not given, for safety
birthday.doctor.role_channel_allows: the role opens extra permissions in {0} channel(s) (e.g. a birthday channel) — it is given
birthday.doctor.scheduler_not_running: FAILED: the background job is not running
birthday.doctor.scheduler_no_pass: started {0}, first pass not finished yet
birthday.doctor.scheduler_stale: FAILED: last successful pass {0} · last error {1}
birthday.doctor.scheduler_ok: running · last successful pass {0} · every {1} s · consecutive failures {2}
birthday.doctor.delivery_dry_run: DryRun — announcements are only logged, not sent to Discord
birthday.privacy.role: {0} Birthday role given by the bot is taken back
birthday.privacy.role_not_removed: the Birthday role given by the bot could not be taken back right now; an admin can remove it by hand

cmd.birthday.set.date: Day and month: 14.03, 14/03 or 14-03 — please enter your real birthday
cmd.birthday.show: Show your saved birthday (only you can see it)
cmd.tsq-admin.birthday.show: Show a member's saved birthday (Administrator only)
cmd.tsq-admin.birthday.show.member: Member whose birthday you want to see
cmd.tsq-admin.birthday.status: Birthday module settings and today's state
cmd.tsq-admin.birthday.doctor: Check channel, role hierarchy, permissions, database and scheduler
